title: NVIDIA Faces A Major Leadership Test After Jensen Huang’s Resignation
title_zh: 黃仁勳辭職後，輝達面臨重大領導考驗
subtitle: 黃仁勳辭職後，輝達面臨重大領導考驗
author: Frank Downing

sentences.en: On Thursday, NVIDIA announced Jensen Huang’s resignation, ending a 33-year tenure at the company he co-founded in 1993.
sentences.zh: 週四，輝達宣布黃仁勳辭職，結束他在這家 1993 年共同創辦的公司長達 33 年的任期。

sentences.en: One of Silicon Valley’s longest-serving founder CEOs, Huang leaves a question beyond succession: how much of NVIDIA’s competitive advantage depended on his relationships and extraordinary bets?
sentences.zh: 身為矽谷任期最長的創辦人執行長之一，黃仁勳留下的問題不只是接班：輝達的競爭優勢有多少是靠他的人脈和非凡的押注？

sentences.en: Colette Kress, Nvidia’s CFO since 2013, is now interim CEO.
sentences.zh: 自 2013 年起擔任輝達財務長的 Colette Kress，現在是代理執行長。

sentences.en: SemiAnalysis has identified executives Ian Buck and Jonah Alben as Jensen’s potential successors, while other reports suggest former Nvidia executive, Arm CEO Rene Haas.
sentences.zh: SemiAnalysis 點名高階主管 Ian Buck 和 Jonah Alben 是黃仁勳可能的接班人，其他報導則提到前輝達高層、現任 Arm 執行長的 Rene Haas。

sentences.en: Highlighting their ties, NVIDIA announced a definitive agreement to acquire Arm in September 2020 but, in response to antitrust opposition and lawsuits, abandoned it in February 2022.
sentences.zh: 雙方關係密切的一個例子是：輝達在 2020 年 9 月宣布簽署收購 Arm 的正式協議，但因反壟斷的反對和訴訟，於 2022 年 2 月放棄。

sentences.en: Jensen’s successor will inherit a founder-led organization with 60 direct reports and significant supply chain relationships.
sentences.zh: 黃仁勳的接班人將接手一個由創辦人領導、有 60 位直屬部下和重要供應鏈關係的組織。

sentences.en: According to SemiAnalysis, Huang’s supplier relationships helped prioritize scarce chip manufacturing capacity for NVIDIA ahead of competitors.
sentences.zh: 根據 SemiAnalysis，黃仁勳和供應商的關係，讓輝達能比競爭對手優先取得稀缺的晶片產能。

sentences.en: Near-term momentum remains substantial: in its latest earnings call, despite projected supply constraints, NVIDIA projected ~70% revenue growth for its fiscal year ended January 2028 and disclosed capacity commitments totaling $279 billion.
sentences.zh: 短期動能依然強勁：在最近一次財報電話會議中，儘管預期供應受限，輝達仍預估截至 2028 年 1 月的財年營收成長約 70%，並揭露總計 2,790 億美元的產能承諾。

sentences.en: These commitments should provide continuity through the transition.
sentences.zh: 這些承諾應能在交接期間維持營運的連續性。

vocab.usage: announce / hand in one's resignation 宣布／遞交辭呈；動詞 resign from…
vocab.example: She handed in her resignation on Monday.
vocab.example_zh: 她週一遞出了辭呈。

vocab.usage: succession plan 接班計畫；名詞 successor 接班人
vocab.example: The board is working on a succession plan.
vocab.example_zh: 董事會正在擬定接班計畫。

vocab.usage: gain / maintain a competitive advantage 取得／維持競爭優勢
vocab.example: Low costs give us a competitive advantage.
vocab.example_zh: 低成本讓我們有競爭優勢。

vocab.usage: interim CEO 代理執行長；interim report 期中報告
vocab.example: He will serve as interim manager.
vocab.example_zh: 他將擔任代理經理。

vocab.usage: successor to + 人／職位；反義 predecessor 前任
vocab.example: The CEO named her successor.
vocab.example_zh: 執行長指定了她的接班人。

vocab.usage: definitive agreement 正式協議（併購新聞常見）
vocab.example: The two firms signed a definitive agreement.
vocab.example_zh: 兩家公司簽了正式協議。

vocab.usage: acquire a company 收購公司；名詞 acquisition（M&A = mergers and acquisitions）
vocab.example: Google acquired the startup last year.
vocab.example_zh: Google 去年收購了這家新創。

vocab.usage: antitrust law / regulators 反壟斷法／機關
vocab.example: The deal faced antitrust concerns.
vocab.example_zh: 這筆交易遭遇反壟斷疑慮。

vocab.usage: abandon a plan / deal 放棄計畫／交易；＝give up（較正式）
vocab.example: They abandoned the project due to costs.
vocab.example_zh: 他們因成本問題放棄了這個專案。

vocab.usage: inherit a problem / team 接手問題／團隊；名詞 inheritance
vocab.example: The new manager inherited a strong team.
vocab.example_zh: 新經理接手了一個很強的團隊。

vocab.zh: 優先處理；排定優先順序
vocab.usage: prioritize A over B；名詞 priority（top priority 最優先）
vocab.example: Please prioritize the urgent orders.
vocab.example_zh: 請優先處理急件訂單。

vocab.usage: scarce resources 稀缺資源；名詞 scarcity
vocab.example: Skilled workers are scarce right now.
vocab.example_zh: 現在技術工很難找。

vocab.usage: gain / lose momentum 增加／失去動能
vocab.example: Sales gained momentum in the spring.
vocab.example_zh: 春季銷售動能增強。

vocab.usage: supply / budget constraints 供應／預算限制；time constraints 時間限制
vocab.example: Budget constraints delayed the project.
vocab.example_zh: 預算限制讓專案延後了。

vocab.usage: disclose information / earnings；名詞 disclosure 揭露事項
vocab.example: Companies must disclose their earnings.
vocab.example_zh: 公司必須揭露獲利。

vocab.usage: business continuity 營運持續（BCP）；provide continuity
vocab.example: We need continuity during the transition.
vocab.example_zh: 交接期間我們需要維持延續性。

vocab.usage: a smooth transition 順利交接；transition period 過渡期
vocab.example: We hope for a smooth transition.
vocab.example_zh: 我們希望能順利交接。

vocab.usage: export restrictions 出口管制；impose restrictions on… 對…設限
vocab.example: There are restrictions on luggage size.
vocab.example_zh: 行李尺寸有限制。

vocab.usage: advocate for… 為…發聲；名詞 advocate 提倡者
vocab.example: He advocates for remote work.
vocab.example_zh: 他提倡遠距工作。

vocab.usage: ＝decrease / reduce（較正式）；diminishing returns 報酬遞減
vocab.example: The risk has diminished over time.
vocab.example_zh: 風險隨時間降低了。

vocab.usage: impose limits / taxes / a fine on… 對…設限／課稅／罰款
vocab.example: The city imposed a fine on the company.
vocab.example_zh: 市府對該公司開罰。

vocab.usage: ＝rely on / depend on；count on someone to do…
vocab.example: You can count on me to finish it.
vocab.example_zh: 你可以指望我把它做完。
